name: pricing-plan-manager
description: Manages flat-rate pricing subscriptions for supported AWS services.

subcommands.name: approve-paid-subscription
subcommands.description: Approves a subscription that is in PENDING_APPROVAL status, activating it and starting billing.

subcommands.name: associate-resources-to-subscription
subcommands.description: Adds one or more resources to an existing subscription.

subcommands.name: cancel-subscription-change
subcommands.description: Cancels a pending scheduled change on a subscription, such as a pending downgrade or cancellation.

subcommands.name: create-subscription
subcommands.description: Creates a flat-rate pricing subscription for the specified resources.

subcommands.name: disassociate-resources-from-subscription
subcommands.description: Removes one or more resources from an existing subscription.

subcommands.name: get-subscription
subcommands.description: Returns the details of a flat-rate pricing subscription, including its current status, associated resources, and any pending scheduled changes.

subcommands.name: list-subscriptions
subcommands.description: Returns a summary of all flat-rate pricing subscriptions in the calling account.

subcommands.name: update-subscription
subcommands.description: Changes the plan tier of an existing subscription.
